for B,C,H,W,atol in [ROWS[4],ROWS[5],ROWS[3]]:
    ins=gen(B,C,H,W); out=torch.empty(B,C,H,W,device='cuda')
    st=torch.zeros(148*24,dtype=torch.int64,device='cuda')
    def fst(*a): run(Ls['shst'],list(a[:11]),a[11],st)
    res={'sh':[], 'shst':[]}
    for rd in range(3):
        res['sh'].append(harness_time(mk(Ls['sh']),ins,[out])); res['shst'].append(harness_time(fst,ins,[out]))
    # plain CUDA-event timing without flush, back-to-back
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
